name: Doki Doki Happy Thoughts
storyline: When Sayori sits down to write her poem, she realizes that in order to be honest with the page, she needs to be honest with herself. Sifting through her happy thoughts, she will also have to delve into the depths of her own suffering if she wants to write true to her heart. Dive into her mind through this visually thought-provoking and profound mod that is sure to leave its mark.
summary: Doki Doki: Happy Thoughts is a modification of the game Doki Doki Literature Club! that offers players a deep immersion into the mind of Sayori, one of the main characters. As she sits down to write her poem, she realizes that in order to be honest on paper, she needs to be honest with herself. As she delves into her happy thoughts, Sayori also faces the depths of her own despair, seeking to write true to her heart. This mod is visually captivating and viscerally written, promising to leave a lasting impression on players.
